symptom: Clicking a JavaScript action (or the Navigation root) in a project-tree client fails: `mxcli describe javascriptaction X` is 'Unknown type', and `describe navigation Navigation` looks for a profile named Navigation
cause: project-tree and describe each kept their own idea of the node types: the tree emits javascriptaction, pagetemplate, domainmodel and ~20 container types, describe's CLI map had no javascriptaction keyword (the executor and grammar did), and the tree's navigation node carries the qualified name 'Navigation', which is not a profile. Every client (vscode-mdl's openElement fallback list) papered over it with its own guess list
insight: Two hand-kept lists over the same set drift; make one side derive from the other and test the source, not a copy. project-tree now marks each node `describable` from describe's own dispatch, and the guard reads every `Type: "x"` literal out of project_tree.go so a new node type fails the test until someone decides whether it has MDL. Revert check: removing the javascriptaction case fails the guard with the exact type named. Measured on Evora: 5748 nodes, 4611 describable, 1137 containers/no-source
